high_level_description: This image depicts a serene and tranquil indoor space with a stunning view of the ocean and a cliffside. The room is designed with a modern yet minimalist aesthetic, featuring wooden slats that cover the ceiling and walls, creating a sense of openness and natural light. The focal point of the room is a rectangular, wooden bathtub filled with water, positioned centrally within the space. The bathtub is elevated slightly above the floor, which is also made of wood, and it appears to be integrated seamlessly into the design.
